method: Read from the production build's route-bundle-stats.json (npm run build:e2e), computed from the tokens for the palette notes, and checked in the in-app browser with the device emulated as dark. NOT the sweep (no Chromium on the machine).
palette: unchanged: brand 700 is #1f4e79 (ADR-086). Three palettes were built and looked at in the live product and not kept.

deepTealWithMarigold.emeraldSuccessBesideTeal: CIELAB distance 18.4 (text) and 15.1 (surface); about 20 is the least that is told apart, so success had to move to hue 120 (42.5 and 17.8)

aquaOnWhite.fill: #62ceda (400) with a dark label; 1.9:1 against a white page, so a one-pixel edge in 600 (#2799a5, 3.2:1) is needed
aquaOnWhite.text: #1e7680 (700), 5.3:1 on white: a link cannot use the fill
aquaOnWhite.consequence: two brand steps (fill and text), a new token pair, about thirteen call sites and a phone change

lightByDefault.foundBy: defaults read -g AppleInterfaceStyle on the owner's Mac printed Dark; the product followed prefers-color-scheme, so the light page had never been on their screen
lightByDefault.checked: device emulated as dark, no stored choice: data-theme absent, body background rgb(248, 249, 250), theme-color #f8f9fa
